children: Falcon Finance will release about 203.06 million FF in April 2027. The FF supply unlock covers tokens for the ecosystem, foundation, investors and team. The amount is equal to 5.73% of the circulating supply.

Once the lock ends, the released tokens become available for sale. If recipients choose to sell some of their newly unlocked tokens, those sales could add to the supply of FF offered on the market and create selling pressure.

title: Falcon Finance: FF Supply Unlock Releases About 203.06 Million Tokens - Apr 2027
